title: Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Organization Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Organization Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2013
ACT V OF 2013
PAKHTUNKHWA HYDEL DEVELOPMENT
ORGANIZATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Hydel
Development
Organization Act, 1993
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
29th January, 2013]
No.PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa/Bills/2013/2679, dated
29-1-2013.---The Pakhtunkhwa Hydel
Development Organization (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 15th
January, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa
on 22nd January,
2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development
Organization Act, 1993, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Pakhtunkhwa Hydel Development Organization (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

"4A. Executive Committee.---(1) There shall be an Executive Committee consisting
of,--
(i)
the Minister for Energy and Power;
Chairman
(ii)
the Additional Chief Secretary to Government;
... Member
(iii)
the Secretary to Government, Finance Department;
Member

and
... Member
(v)
the Managing Director of the Organization.
... Member
(2) The Executive Committee shall perform
such functions as may be delegated to it by the Board from time to time.".
